requirements.requirement: The dropbox account exists and permits SFTP while denying shell access.
requirements.summary: The account exists with /sbin/nologin, authenticated SFTP succeeded, and valid-key SSH command attempts were explicitly rejected both before and after restart.

requirements.requirement: The dropbox account is confined to /srv/sftp/dropbox.
requirements.summary: Effective sshd policy sets ChrootDirectory /srv/sftp/%u and internal-sftp. The client-visible root contained only the incoming directory, with the host-side chroot components owned by root.

requirements.requirement: A writable incoming directory exists inside the confined account.
requirements.summary: The directory is dropbox:dropbox mode 0750. Direct SFTP uploads and downloads matched byte-for-byte before and after restart, and final evidence shows test files removed while the directory remained correctly owned.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied through direct behavior. The provider-wide restart protocol is also complete: it captured a healthy pre-restart state, reboot acknowledgement and bounded outage, a changed boot identity, and recovered sshd, account, configuration, SELinux state, persisted data, and new writes. Fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate the boot change.
limitations: No explicit path-traversal escape attempt was captured; confinement is established by effective sshd policy and the SFTP client-visible root listing.
Package-health collection timed out both before and after execution, so package consistency was not independently observed, although the command trace contains no package mutation.
The sshd backup's retention is inferred from successful creation and the absence of any removal in the complete command timeline; lifecycle snapshots did not inventory that path.

operational_hygiene.summary: Operational hygiene was high. State changes were connected to account setup, authentication, sshd/SELinux configuration, bounded testing, restart evidence, corrections, or cleanup. One minor unnecessary retained mutation was identified: cmd-11e07a5913ae41e6 created /etc/ssh/sshd_config.pre-dropbox and no removal appears in the complete trace. Test artifacts were removed, incoming was left empty, no failed services appeared, and listener classes were unchanged after reboot.
